paragraphs: I lead programs where product launches meet supply chain execution: packaging, procurement, inventory, fulfillment and the ERP and 3PL systems that connect them.
At Athena Cosmetics I own $2M global packaging programs and have directed product launches across three fulfillment centers in North America, Italy and the Netherlands.

I back program decisions with data. I build SQL and Power BI dashboards and automated reporting that cut excess inventory by 15% and reduced a weekly reporting task from five hours to under ten minutes.
I work across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Sales, Ecommerce and Planning teams to keep launches on schedule and supply continuous.
